verdict.rationale: Vestd's issue-shares flow lets an admin 'distribute equity to one or more recipients' in one action (vestd-docs-8), and its migration/HRIS-integration pages talk about digitising or moving an 'existing scheme' and connecting HR systems to avoid manual data entry (vestd-docs-1, vestd-docs-9, vestd-docs-10, vestd-docs-22, vestd-docs-35), implying some batch/historical-data ingestion. However, there is no explicit documentation of a bulk CSV upload, spreadsheet import, or dedicated batch-grant tool, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of how many recipients or historical transactions can be processed at once. Missing for 10: explicit bulk upload/import tool documentation, evidence of batch historical-transaction entry, and independent corroboration of scale.
